gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically verified glioblastoma multiforme with recurrence (first or second relapse, all subtypes)

candidate_evidence.quote: Sulfasalazine is a potential tumor selective radiosensitizer.
Sulfasalazine inhibits the production of an antioxidant that normally protects the tumor against radiation.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Sulfasalazine and Stereotactic Radiosurgery for Recurrent Glioblastoma

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Monitor the effect of sulfasalazine on the level of Glutathione production in glioma cells.

role_evidence.quote: Sulfasalazine in addition to stereotactic radiosurgery
This study evaluates the safety associated with the addition of sulfasalazine to stereotactic radiosurgery for recurrent glioblastoma.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: inhibits production of an antioxidant that protects the tumour against radiation (radiosensitiser)
arms: Sulfasalazine in addition to stereotactic radiosurgery

source_quote.quote: Monitor the effect of sulfasalazine on the level of Glutathione production in glioma cells.

coder_notes: Single registered arm typed OTHER (dose escalation of sulfasalazine before gamma knife radiosurgery); sulfasalazine is the only drug, radiosurgery is the partner so regimen is combination. Gamma knife is the radiation modality, not a device needed to activate or deliver the drug, so device_dependent is false.
